permutation_test.note: 200 ridge refits on label-shuffled training targets (alpha fixed at the CV-selected value), each scored against the real 2024 test set -- the null distribution of R2 achievable with no genuine train/test relationship.

block_bootstrap_by_date.note: 1000 resamples of whole trading days (not individual rows) with replacement, tradable blend predictions, 95% percentile interval.
